# Genesis Apocryphon Column 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 16 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed; only scattered words survive

---

**16:1** [...] the-vineyard [...] and-Noah planted [...] upon-the-mountain [...]

**16:2** [...] and-he-drank from-the-wine [...] and-became-drunk [...]

**16:3** [...] and-he-lay-uncovered [...] in-the-midst-of his-tent [...]

**16:4** [...] Ham [...] saw [...] the-nakedness of-his-father [...]

**16:5** [...] and-told his-two-brothers [...] in-the-outside [...]

**16:6** [...] Shem and-Japheth [...] and-they-covered [...] their-father [...]

**16:7** [...] and-Noah awoke [...] and-knew what-his-son had-done to-him [...]

**16:8** [...] cursed [...] Canaan [...] a-servant of-servants shall-he-be [...]

**16:9** [...] to-his-brothers [...] and-blessed the-LORD God-of Shem [...]

**16:10** [...]

---

*EMET notes: Column 16 is nearly destroyed. The surviving fragments retell the episode of Noah's vineyard (Gen 9:20-27) in Aramaic. "The nakedness of his father" ('ervat 'avuhi) follows the Genesis account. The curse falls on Canaan, Ham's son, not on Ham directly. Construct chains preserved with hyphens.*
